name: Pig launcher / receiver for the export pipeline
description: Pig traps launch and receive pigs to clean or inspect flowlines between manifold and platform / along export pipelines. SPEC Oil & Gas lists pig launchers and receivers among its ancillary equipment (page read). Patent US4135949A describes the safety interlock problem: inadvertent opening of a pressurised receiver or admission of fluid while the closure is off is a hazard to personnel and the environment. Primary source: https://patents.google.com/patent/US4135949A/en
aliases: Pig launcher / receiver for the export pipeline(s)

specifications.metric: Pig launcher / receiver (pig trap) — Example pig receiver station diameter vs pipeline
specifications.basis: US4135949A: 'a thirty inch diameter pipeline can have a forty-two inch diameter station which usually will be of length considerably greater than the diameter of the pipe'

specifications.metric: Pig launcher / receiver (pig trap) — Interlock preferred setpoint
specifications.basis: US4135949A: pressures up to about ten pounds preferred; 'a pressure of about 5 psig is most preferred because of convenience'

specifications.metric: Pig launcher / receiver (pig trap) — Safe-to-open closure pressure setpoint
specifications.basis: US4135949A: 'By choosing a setpoint of about 1/2 to about 1 psig it can be assured that the vessel is free of dangerous pressure levels before the operation of opening the vessel can begin'
